name: rust-small
description: Small deterministic Rust refactor tasks for AIR code-agent baselines.

tasks.prompt: Refactor src/math.rs by extracting the arithmetic inside add_then_double into a small private helper named sum_pair. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.
Refactor src/config.rs by extracting the per-character environment key normalization from env_key into a small private helper named normalize_key_char. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.
Refactor src/collections.rs by extracting the active-item predicate from active_names into a small private helper named is_active_item. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.
Refactor src/http.rs by extracting the numeric status classification from status_class into a small private helper named classify_status_code. Preserve behavior and run cargo test.
